answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns twice its 30-day earnings, locked for 20 epochs; the receipt is the kernel of its identity, checked before paid work. Making 100 slots costs 200 months of earnings, while one honest agent pays once and recovers it in 6 months undiluted. A reef builds slowly; copies built on shale crumble in audit without a matching burn. Rented reputation slashes sponsor and slot.
